intro.title: Bootstrap this project’s .claude/
intro.body: Analyses the codebase, the existing .claude/ configuration, and (optionally) conversation frictions, then proposes one coherent plan covering CLAUDE.md, rules, subagents, hooks, permissions, MCP and output styles. You review and approve every entity before anything is written.
